title: Pais's career at Navy programs and Space Force

tellings.quote: fortunate to work for strategic systems programs at the Washington Navy Yard and then uh I went for the Space Force and

plain: A Navy scientist named Salvatore Pais describes his own career on the show. He says he was "fortunate to work for strategic systems programs at the Washington Navy Yard," a Navy office in Washington, D.C., and then moved on to the Space Force.
